# Rule: Calling convention respelled via a macro

_Canonical rule slug:_ `calling-convention-respelled-via-macro`. [← back to all rules](index.md)

> A declaration's calling-convention attribute moves from a literal spelling to a macro that expands to the same convention, so the binary interface is unchanged.
